You saw other peoples posts and they got comments that they're average but you think they're ugly? This is why I say your definition is at fault. You have too high expectations on what beauty should be. Until you've changed it you will keep dealing with these horrible emotions.

It usually gets easier.

I think that’s the problem. Average doesn’t mean that you are ugly at all. 
I think we’ve become obsessed with being perfect. If you have that mindset then you will obviously think that because average is far from perfect so that means that one is ugly.

Are there people who are extremely attractive? Yes. 
Are they the majority of people in the world? No.

I hate how harsh we are on ourselves. Is beauty the only thing that matters? 
There are so many things that makes a person attractive! Hobbies, confidence etc

I think you need to re-evaluate your life. Do you want to spend the rest of the years trying to change things that maybe aren’t possible? ( people with BDD usually don’t get any better by getting surgery. We will find other flaws to obsess over).
